description: This file implements a login page component for a Next.js application, handling user login, form state, and server-side redirection based on authentication token.

methods.name: LoginPage
methods.description: React functional component for the login page, managing form inputs, submission, and navigation.

methods.name: handleInputChange
methods.description: Updates form data state when user inputs change.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, performs login API call, manages success or error, and redirects.

methods.name: handlePasswordReset
methods.description: Redirects user to password reset page.
